title: rustfs-gateway operation IR, version 2 (frozen)
description: Shape of one operation IR document. One AWS operation per file. IR is a generated artifact: model/s3.json (pinned) + model/overlays/*.toml -> xtask codegen -> IR -> spec/, OPERATIONS.md, generated/**. Never hand-edit outside spec/ir/samples/, which are hand-written goldens for codegen. additionalProperties:false is enforced on every object so that a leaked Smithy trait (notably smithy.api#documentation) fails validation instead of entering the wire contract.

ir_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this schema. A bump requires a fresh IR-FREEZE review.

operation.description: AWS official operation name. Equals the file stem.

shapes.description: Every structure/union shape reachable from input or output, keyed by shape name. Denormalized on purpose: an IR document is self-contained, so no consumer ever needs a second file to emit a codec. Divergence is impossible because all copies come from one codegen run.

derived_resources.description: Resources that can only be read out of the input after a second authorization step (CopySource is the canonical case). Empty for operations with a single resource.

head_mirrors.description: For HEAD operations: the GET operation whose response header set must be reproduced field for field. Derived relation, never two hand-written bindings.

quirk_refs.description: Operation-scoped quirks. Field-scoped and shape-member-scoped quirks are referenced from the field itself.

quirks.description: Resolved quirk records for every id referenced anywhere in this document. Set equality with the union of all quirk_refs is a semantic check, not a schema check.

ext_points.description: Dialect extension points. Shape is frozen here; the P1-08 spike decides which strategy value is used in practice.

then.description: A privileged surface must never be reachable through a presigned URL.
With an unwrapped output the single BodyXml field is the root element, so there is no sibling order to fix.

member_path.description: A member name, or a dotted path into a nested shape (Contents.Key).

precedence.description: Explicit position in the ordered first-match route table; lower wins. Assigned by codegen from model/overlays/route.toml, never hand-written in Rust.

predicates.description: Conjunction that decides WHICH operation this is. Routing only: a query key that is merely mandatory (?analytics needs id) belongs in input.fields[].required with a missing_error, so that omitting it is a 400, not a 501.

success_status.description: Default success status. 204 for the delete family, 206 for a satisfied Range GET, 303 for a POST Object redirect.

alt_success_statuses.description: Other success statuses this operation may legitimately return, e.g. POST Object with success_action_status / success_action_redirect.

path_shape.description: Reverse index key for OPERATIONS.md: /, /{Bucket}, /{Bucket}/{Key+}, or a literal path.

predicate.description: The nine route predicates. This list is closed and mirrors rustfs-gateway-core RouteSelector one for one.

prefix.description: Matched against the header value as a prefix, so that Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=... is expressible. Must be non-empty: use HeaderPresent to test for the header alone.

negated.description: When true the predicate matches only if the header is absent.

oneOf.description: Routes on the mere presence of a header, independent of its value. This is how AWS separates operations that share a method and path shape: PutObject vs CopyObject and UploadPart vs UploadPartCopy differ only by x-amz-copy-source being present. Modelling that as HeaderPrefix with an empty prefix conflates two different questions and was rejected.

requirement.description: AnonymousAllowed means anonymous is a legitimate identity, never a fallback after a failed signature.

action.description: IAM action. An operation without an action mapping must not be registered, so this is never empty.

service.description: SigV4 credential-scope service. Cross-checked against the routed operation so an sts-scoped signature cannot reach an s3 operation.

kind.description: Literal is a bare non-XML body (a MinIO dialect case). EventStream is the SelectObjectContent framing.

buffering.description: Full means the body must be complete before the handler runs. Deferred means headers are flushed before the outcome is known, which is only legal together with errors.allows_error_after_200.

max_bytes.description: Hard size cap for a buffered body (XML bomb ceiling). null only for streaming or empty bodies.

http_checksum_required.description: The httpChecksumRequired operation set: a missing Content-MD5 and missing x-amz-checksum-* is a 400 InvalidRequest before the handler runs.

wire_name.description: Name on the wire: header name, query key, URI label, x-amz-meta- prefix, or XML element name. null only for Payload and StatusCode bindings, which have no name.

required.description: Wire-level requirement. Missing a required field is a parameter validation failure (missing_error), never a routing failure.

hot.description: Cold/hot split: hot fields live on the stack, cold fields move into Option<Box<ColdOpts>> so Req<O> stays small.

default.description: Wire default applied when the field is absent (MaxKeys 1000). Emitted only when non-null.

missing_error.description: Error code returned when a required field is absent. Emitted only for required fields. This is what keeps missing ?analytics&id a 400 instead of a 501.

binding.description: The Smithy http binding traits, plus FormField for POST Object where the key arrives as a multipart form field.

oneOf.description: wire_name carries the prefix itself, e.g. x-amz-meta-.

omit_when.description: When a present value must still not be written to the wire. x-amz-storage-class is omitted for STANDARD while the XML StorageClass element is always written, so this is per field, not per shape.

oneOf.description: Emitted only when a request field has some value, e.g. Owner appears only when fetch-owner=true.

type.description: Scalar vocabulary. The IR only names a type; rustfs-gateway-types implements it. Nothing here has a default, so every rendering context is stated explicitly.

oneOf.description: Round-tripped byte for byte, never parsed. Expires uses this: stored values are frequently not dates.
Three rendering contexts, no default: header always quoted, XML normally quoted, GetObjectAttributes bare.
The packed algorithm+value form that replaces eleven Option<String> members on the hot path.
An untrusted server-minted token that grants no authority until the named exchange produces its resolved capability.
Generates a newtype over Cow<'static, str> with associated constants, never a real enum: AWS adds values every quarter.

fields.description: Members of a nested shape. Bindings are BodyXml (or Header for shapes reused in header positions).

element_order.description: Wire contract for this shape's direct children. Must cover exactly the shape's BodyXml members.

request_root.description: Wire root element of the request body, which frequently differs from the Smithy shape name (CompleteMultipartUpload vs CompletedMultipartUpload).

request_root_aliases.description: Additional root element names accepted on decode.

xmlns.description: emit writes the 2006-03-01 namespace on the root. The Error root must suppress it. Namespaces on request bodies are always ignored, which is a global rule and not per operation.

unwrapped_output.description: true when the single BodyXml output member IS the root element rather than a child of an output wrapper (GetBucketLocation).

element_order.description: Order of the response root's direct children. Wire contract: strict clients break when Name follows Contents.

url_encoded_fields.description: Members that must be percent-encoded when encoding-type=url was requested. Dotted paths reach into nested shapes.

body_literal.description: Accept a bare literal (non-XML) body. MinIO dialect only.

empty_value_policy.description: Per member: emit an empty element or omit it entirely. ListObjects must write <Prefix></Prefix>; GetBucketVersioning must not write <Status></Status>.

name.description: Attribute name including any prefix, e.g. xsi:type on Grantee.

not_configured.description: The operation-specific 404 returned when a bucket subresource was never configured (NoSuchLifecycleConfiguration, NoSuchTagSet, ...). A code-to-status table alone cannot express this.

allows_error_after_200.description: The response can carry an Error body after a 200 status line and headers were already flushed (CompleteMultipartUpload, CopyObject, UploadPartCopy). Forces the deferred-outcome response type.

codes.description: Error codes this operation can produce; feeds the error-code to operation reverse index.

derived_resource.description: The associated type that makes a second authorization mandatory before the value can be read (CopySource). Missing this is how GHSA-mx42/-wfxj happened.

kind.description: Quirk category (xmlns, root_name, flattened, element_order, timestamp_format, empty_value, omit_when, encoding_type, etag_render, unwrapped_output, xml_attribute, success_status, checksum_required, body_literal, ...). Deliberately not an enum: new AWS behaviour must not require a schema bump.

target.description: What the quirk applies to: Operation, Shape, Shape.Member, or Operation.Field.

summary.description: Self-written one-liner. Never paste upstream prose.

cases.description: Conformance cases that would fail if the quirk were flipped. The reverse direction (case references quirk) is checked by scripts/check_quirks_evidence.sh.

ref.description: URL, issue number, or repo-relative capture path.

summary.description: Self-written summary of what the source establishes. Upstream issue text stays copyrighted, so only URL plus own words are stored.

strategy.description: The two possible outcomes of the P1-08 spike. ExtField means one generated codec plus a runtime vtable. GeneratedVariant means a second generated codec behind cfg_feature, i.e. the spike failed and generated code doubles for this dialect.

cfg_feature.description: Cargo feature gating the second codec. Required by GeneratedVariant, must be null for ExtField.

position.description: Extension elements are written after every known member. Frozen as a single value so that element order stays a wire contract.

unknown_policy.description: Decode behaviour for unregistered unknown elements. Security-relevant configuration bodies default to allow-registered; ordinary request XML defaults to lenient for AWS forward compatibility.
